name: Narendra Modi
real_life_parallel: Prime Minister of India (2014-present); central to all retaliatory decisions 2016-2025

biography.background: Prime Minister of India throughout 2016-2025 period. Central decision-maker for Uri surgical strikes (2016), Balakot airstrike (2019), Operation Sindoor (2025). Represents 'Modi-Doval security doctrine' shift from strategic restraint to punitive deterrence.
biography.doctrine: Punitive deterrence; 'new India' muscular response; political ownership of military retaliation
biography.film_relevance: Part 3: Uri, Balakot, Article 370. Part 4: Galwan, Sindoor.

key_decisions.surgical_strikes_2016: Authorized cross-LoC Para SF strikes post-Uri
key_decisions.balakot_2019: Authorized IAF strike deep inside Pakistan post-Pulwama
key_decisions.article_370_2019: Revoked J&K special status; bifurcated into UTs
key_decisions.operation_sindoor_2025: Authorized missile/air strikes on 9 terror sites across Pakistan/PoK post-Pahalgam

oracle_note: Non-playable as operative (political leadership). Appears as authorization node in strategic decision trees.
